correctness.rationale: The exact greedy-run index J=delta+t+2 sum(ceil(r_i/c_i)-1) is proved by induction on candidate runs and exhausts every possible subsequence embedding. For a,b>=2, the run-cost corrections E_c(r) are nonpositive and equality is classified, proving both universality through length 2k-1 and the entire shortest-absent set; generating functions yield Fibonacci, power of two, and singleton formulas. For min(a,b)=1, every k-letter candidate embeds using one symbol per two-run block, and the remaining length-k+1 candidates are exhausted by zero-count and symmetry. Exhaustive direct verification for all 216 triples a,b,k=1..6 confirms exact missing sets and all shorter candidate words; an extra symbolic count sanity check reaches k=69. Finite runs corroborate, not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The exact forbidden scattered-subsequence language for all positive a,b,k is intrinsically motivated by repetitively run-length-encoded test strings for subsequence indexing. Five sharp parameter regimes (linear, constant two, Fibonacci, binary exponential, singleton) including abrupt transitions at run length two give a complete structural phase diagram and explain the boundaries through run embedding and generating functions, not an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
